title: Postleitzahlen-Geokoordinaten — Deutschland
description: 8,298 German postal codes (Postleitzahlen, PLZ) with WGS84 geographic centroid coordinates (latitude / longitude). Sourced from the Gemeindeverzeichnis of the German Federal Statistical Office (Statistisches Bundesamt) and geocoded via the Google Cloud Geocoding API (January 2019). Each record carries the 5-digit PLZ, lat/lng of the PLZ-area centroid, and the first-digit Postleitzone (0-9) with its regional label. Complements the existing PLZ-Ort/Landkreis/Bundesland datasets by adding actual coordinates for map-rendering, distance queries, and reverse-geocode lookups.
